images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit Image 1, the supplied 1254×1254 canvas, to deliver exactly one 2×2 sprite sheet. KEEP THE ENTIRE TOP-LEFT 627×627 SLOT 0 PIXEL-IDENTICAL. Fill only the three empty green slots: top-right frame 10, bottom-left frame 11, bottom-right frame 12 of a 16-frame relaxed breathing idle-S loop (2 seconds at 8 fps). No borders, labels, gutters, floor shadows or insignia. Flat pure #00ff00 plate everywhere outside the character. Do not matte, mirror, zoom, or change canvas framing.

Identity: exact young woman in slot 0; dark curly hair tied back; ivory rolled-sleeve shirt; navy sleeveless tabard with plain chest; one diagonal chestnut harness to an olive canvas satchel on her anatomical LEFT hip; one belt; laced bracers; navy trousers; chestnut boots; plain walnut staff with brass ferrules held upright in her anatomical RIGHT hand. All new cells copy slot 0's character size, head size, cell-local position and baseline. Every character faces S toward camera, fixed Godot-informed elevated three-quarter projection C. Single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on key-facing edge. No warm or saturated spell light in these idle frames.

Animation: ONE full breath per loop. Frame 4 peak inhale, frame 8 rest, frame 12 bottom exhale, frame 16 rest. The requested frames progressively exhale toward frame 12. At frame 10, chest/shoulders width delta at least -5.4 px, head y delta -1.0 px; frame 11 width at least -7.1 px, head y -1.3 px; frame 12 width at least -7.7 px, head y -1.4 px (image-down positive; never exceed 2 px head translation). These width changes are MINIMUMS. EXAGGERATE THE BREATH at CARTOON scale, about a third bigger than life, so it reads in hand-drawn game animation: the peak inhale would have shoulders RISE and chest/collar SWELL WIDER by about 25 px, and here at frame 12 the shoulders DROP and the whole chest narrows by about 25 px below rest, the tabard slackening. Frame 10 approaches this narrower dropped chest, frame 11 gets closer, frame 12 reaches the full obvious narrowed exhale. Harness follows chest. If in doubt, draw the breath BIGGER, never smaller. ONLY shoulders, chest/collar, and hair animate. Head is carried minutely by breath and otherwise a COPY of rest; do not redraw face or eyes, gaze fixed.

COPY PIXEL-FOR-PIXEL from rest, translated only into each new cell: hips, legs, both feet and soles, both arms and hands, staff grip and tip, satchel, belt, face and eyes. Trace these, do not redraw them. Sleeves may widen/narrow with chest but arms do not move. Same planted baseline and same staff placement in each cell. No per-frame scaling or upscaling. Keep original slot 0 completely untouched.

Style register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game, confident hand-drawn dark contour with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouettes, no conspicuous grain. The line carries the pose. Each frame looks like a hand-drawn animation frame. Faction Keepers of Hours, blue / ivory / brass, preserve approved costume exactly. No source-game names or copied characters. The output is the native sheet; any frame extraction, uniform downscale and registration are downstream, do not perform them.
RETRY CORRECTION: The previous attempt altered the locked top-left rest frame, especially face, eyes and painted contour. This is unacceptable for this edit. Use the ORIGINAL attached canvas, not a redraw. Preserve every original pixel in the entire top-left quadrant, including its exact face, fine linework, colors and green background. Treat slot 0 as an immutable pasted image. Copy that original sprite into each empty quadrant at exactly +627 x, +627 y, or both, then edit ONLY the chest/shoulder/collar/hair breathing regions of those three copies. Preserve the copied face, belt, satchel, arms, legs, boots and staff. Keep native 1254×1254 size and perfectly flat pure #00ff00, with no texture or color variations in the plate. In the bottom row, baseline must be exactly the original baseline +627 pixels. Make the progressively narrowing exhale chest obvious, reaching roughly 25 px narrower at frame 12.
